objective.text: The moth is moving: WALK and chalk the house on the board
The moth is still: FREEZE (do not step onto a new tile)

start.title: Gentle Carousel
start.text: Walk onto a tile to chalk it and light its lamp. Chalked tiles crumble soon after. You may only step while the blue moth flutters; step while it rests and the shy dark startles (3 frights and it flees). Trace the house shown on the board without more than 2 smudges.

sim.name: win: trace the house by walking only while the moth moves
mechanic: chalked tiles crumble behind you (decay) and unvisited ground is revealed ahead
mechanic: stepping while the moth rests startles the dark and sends you home
lose: three stumbles and the dark flees
lose: loitering on a chalked tile until it crumbles drops you into the dark
lose: three smudges (off-picture tiles) and it is not a house
